request.spec:
The sheet has grace days (settings, a whole number, blank means off, not dated; SETTING_CHANGED
key=grace-days value=<days>). When the sheet's today is changed, every open period whose to-date
plus the grace days is before the new today is closed, in order of their to-dates, exactly as a
close by hand would, each writing PERIOD_CLOSED with auto=yes at its end; these lines come after
the new today is set and before the rollup lines of the today change.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has grace days (settings, a whole number, blank means off, not dated; SETTING_CHANGED
key=grace-days value=<days>). When the sheet's today is changed, every open period whose to-date
plus the grace days is before the new today is closed, in order of their to-dates, exactly as a
close by hand would, each writing PERIOD_CLOSED with auto=yes at its end; these lines come after
the new today is set and before the rollup lines of the today change.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Auto-close on a today change is in, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**Grace days setting**
- The settings form has a new grace days field (`setting-grace-days`, with its value shown in `setting-grace-days-current`). It takes a whole number of days; blank means off. Anything else is refused with `settings-error`.
- It has no from-date and logs `SETTING_CHANGED key=grace-days value=<days>`.
- It is stored like the permission settings, as an undated entry in the existing `sheet_setting` table, so no database migration was needed.

**Auto-close**
- I added a new step, `period/AutoClosePeriods.java`, to `today.PUT.yml`. It runs after the new today is saved and before the rollup lines are written.
- When grace days are set, it closes every open period whose to-date plus the grace days is before the new today, earliest to-date first.
- Each one uses the same totals calculation as a close by hand: I moved that out of `ClosePeriod` so both share it. Each writes `PERIOD_CLOSED … total=<x> auto=yes`.
- The manual close's own log line is unchanged.

**One choice for you:** the request says "exactly as a close by hand would", but doesn't say what happens if the user changing today isn't allowed to close periods under the sheet's permission settings. I made it skip the auto-close in that case and still accept the new today, rather than refusing the date change. The tests don't cover this, so tell me if you'd rather it refuse.
